newsitem.title: UK: Russia's SUN Brewing defers capital rise.
newsitem.headline: Russia's SUN Brewing defers capital rise.

text.p: Russia's SUN Brewing, which in November announced that it intended to raise additional cash to invest in plant and working capital, is to defer its plans to increase capital.
"It (SUN) is negotiating other sources of capital in the interim," said the company whose global depositary receipts (GDRs) are listed in Luxembourg.
SUN also said in a statement that the ownership of some assets at its 60 percent owned subsidiary, Yekatarinburg Brewing Company, was disputed by some of Yekatatinburg's management.
"We believe that we will achieve a solution which is satisfactory to all parties," said Max Asgari, SUN's chief executive.
SUN said that it had resolved a dispute with the management of the Kursk Brewing CO and will finance investments worth $10 million to $15 million in Kursk's malting capacity and brewhouse.
The company also said it expects to complete the acquisition of a 75 percent stake in brewer AO Povolzhe by early 1997. -- David Chance London newsroom 44 171 542 5887
